facts.text: A spec with malformed frontmatter is refused by bin/scout before any model run starts, when parseSpec returns an error.
facts.hit: Before launching a model, bin/scout rejects malformed spec frontmatter on an error result from parseSpec.

facts.text: A spec without a plan (no numbered step with a check: line) is refused by bin/scout before any model run starts.
facts.hit: bin/scout rejects a spec missing numbered plan steps with a check: line before launching the model.
Malformed-frontmatter rejection or missing-plan rejection terminates scout with exit status 2.

facts.text: The parser, parseSpec, lives in config/pi/extensions/worker-sensors.ts.

decoys: The default thinking level in config/pi/settings.json is medium.
scout --fork starts the child from a copy of the parent session, which re-bills the whole parent context.
worktreeRefusal in config/pi/extensions/auto-run.ts refuses git worktree add into a path inside the repo.
